# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 11 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 5 tokens; Shadow — 1 token.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #fff4e8);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface, #22101c);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #fff4e8;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #fff4e8 | #22101c | Page background (cream). Default ground for everything. |
| `--surface-raised` | #ffffff | #3a1530 | Cards, sheets and dialogs above surface. |
| `--surface-sunken` | #f6e3d3 | #2d1525 | Set-apart areas: filter bars, footer, icon backgrounds. |

/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */

/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #3a1530 | #fff4e8 | Body text and headings on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (≥ 12:1). |
| `--ink-muted` | #6e4a62 | #d9bfcb | Secondary text: delivery time, metadata, help text. ≥ 5.9:1 on every surface token. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--line, #ead3c3);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--line, #4a2340);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #ead3c3;
```

### Tokens (11)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--line` | #ead3c3 | #4a2340 | Decorative dividers. Not for form field borders (too little contrast). |
| `--control-border` | #6e4a62 | #b795a8 | Borders of input fields, checkboxes and secondary buttons (≥ 3:1). |
| `--brand-berry` | #d6336c | #d6336c | Logo face and illustrations. NEVER a text colour or a background for small text: cream on it is only 4.3:1. |
| `--action` | #c2255f | #f06a98 | Primary buttons, active tabs, basket badge. Exactly one primary action per screen. |
| `--link` | #b0245a | #f06a98 | Text links on surface and surface-raised (≥ 5.4:1). |
| `--focus` | #b0245a | #f06a98 | Focus ring, 3 px wide with a 2 px offset from the element. |
| `--cheese` | #ffcb45 | #ffcb45 | Highlight: offer badges, new markers, stars. Text on it is always on-cheese. |
| `--crust` | #e09a3a | #e09a3a | Illustration only (pizza crust, crumbs). No UI use. |
| `--pepperoni` | #c0392b | #c0392b | Illustration only (pepperoni). Use error for errors. |
| `--error` | #c0392b | #ff8a7a | Error text and error borders, always with an icon and text, never colour alone. |
| `--success` | #2e7d4f | #6fd49a | Confirmations: order accepted, rider on the way. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 800 64px/64px "Baloo 2", "Nunito Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display-xl); letter-spacing: -0.02em;
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display-xl` | `.display-xl`, `--text-display-xl` | 64px / 64px, letter-spacing -0.02em | 800 | `display` | Landing page hero, at most one line per screen. |
| `display-l` | `.display-l`, `--text-display-l` | 44px / 48px, letter-spacing -0.015em | 800 | `display` | Page titles. |
| `heading` | `.heading`, `--text-heading` | 28px / 34px | 800 | `display` | Section headings. |
| `heading-s` | `.heading-s`, `--text-heading-s` | 20px / 26px | 800 | `display` | Restaurant names on cards, dialog titles. |
| `body-l` | `.body-l`, `--text-body-l` | 18px / 28px | 400 | `sans` | Introductions, marketing copy. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 16px / 24px | 400 | `sans` | Default body text, dish descriptions. |
| `body-strong` | `.body-strong`, `--text-body-strong` | 16px / 24px | 700 | `sans` | Prices, emphasis in body text. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 14px / 20px | 700 | `sans` | Buttons, tabs, form labels. |
| `caption` | `.caption`, `--text-caption` | 13px / 18px | 600 | `sans` | Metadata in ink-muted. Never smaller than 13 px. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `--font-display` | `"Baloo 2", "Nunito Sans", system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"Nunito Sans", system-ui, sans-serif` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Gap between icon and label. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Gap between badges, tight lists. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Padding of chips and small buttons. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Card padding, mobile page margin. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Gap between cards. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Desktop page margin. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Gap between sections. |
| `--space-16` | 64px | Hero padding. |

## Shadow

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--shadow-card: 0 1px 0 rgba(58,21,48,0.06), 0 8px 24px rgba(58,21,48,0.08) in the light theme; the table gives its value in the others) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--shadow-card), so that a change to tokens.css, or a change of theme, reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | value | usage |

| `--shadow-card` | 0 1px 0 rgba(58,21,48,0.06), 0 8px 24px rgba(58,21,48,0.08) · dark: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.35) | Cards above surface. The only shadow level. |
